newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks start lower amid profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks start lower amid profit-taking.

text.p: MADRID, July 7 (Reuter) 0825 GMT - Madrid stocks were lower in early trade on Monday as broad profit-taking after recent gains took the top of the indices.
Bond losses and weakness on other European bourses were also weighing on prices, dealers said.
Amid little corporate news, the day was expected to be fairly dull, with all eyes on Wall Street's open after the Independence Day holiday.
But the underlying tone in Spain remains bullish, dealers said.
* General index down 2.76 points, 0.44 percent, to 623.03
Nearly half of turnover so far today was accounted by put through orders, dealers said.
They were not ruling out the bourse reversing the trend to end higher today.
Telefonica was particularly strong, adding 70 pesetas to 4,620, while Repsol was up 40 pesetas to 6,570.
Later this week focus will turn to June inflation data, due on Friday. Most expect a slight pick-up from May's 1.5 percent year-on-year rate.
